# Carts published to the web by .github/workflows/publish-web.yml.
#
# One cart name per line (the .c filename stem in tools/carts/). Lines starting with #
# are ignored. Every push to master that touches tools/carts/ or runtime/ republishes
# this list, so adding a showcase cart here in the same PR as the cart is what makes it
# audible on a phone without anyone at a desk.
#
# Keep it SHORT. Each entry is an emcc compile on every run.
